method: Individually read the exact Wikimedia Commons file-description page for creator, uploader's subject description and stated file-specific licence. displayRequirements: Before publication visually inspect actual pixels, recheck each file's current Commons description and rights, display creator, exact file page, licence link and changes notice; observe CC BY-SA ShareAlike on adaptations. Public-domain author credits are courteous. Country gateway pins are not the photographed site coordinates.
